To get out of bed.

Example: I wash my face before breakfast.

cards.back:

Example: I brush my teeth twice a day.

cards.back:
To put on your clothes.

Example: I have rice for breakfast.

Bahasa Indonesia: makan malam
Example: Dinner is ready at seven.

Example: I go to school by bike.

Example: I come home at two o'clock.

Bahasa Indonesia: pekerjaan rumah
Example: I do my homework before dinner.

Example: I take a shower every morning.

cards.back:

Bahasa Indonesia: mandi berendam
Example: The baby has a warm bath.

To put things in the right place.

Example: I tidy my room on Saturdays.
